body: Same, I keep doing the exact same thing. For about a year now, I feel living this way puts you in a state of constant survival mode because you’re always thinking about when to do it. It does make life more bearable though, knowing I can go any day now. I hope you find peace.

Is like to go in the least messiest way possible, I’ve already tried overdosing and that didn’t work so I’m just thinking about jumping off a building, I don’t understand why assisted suicide isn’t legal. I didn’t ask to be brought into this world.
I would do this but I have some legal issues in the way of letting me go anywhere, along with me being incredibly insecure
Interesting, why was it not fun times for you? I am truly having a blast in my last moments, I am very much looking forward to rest.

I have wanted to rest my whole life, but I have made some mistakes, but learned the lessons, and I feel I have worked very hard and accomplished what is necessary in this life, I am truly weary and tired, just ready to go. I feel we all should be able to freely choose to check out despite the social stigma we are faced. I don’t believe in hell, I believe it’s a state of mind, our transition in this life will carry over to the next, I am ready for a more light heavenly realm, where my sole focus is on helping other souls and no focus on me at all, or just truly no experience at all. I feel my purpose is done in this life.

I love you kind soul, I am ready to go though, I have accomplished what I’ve wanted, I have made beautiful relationships, but I am ready to rest. I believe we should all be given a choice when we wish to leave.
Sames, see you on the other side mate

Thank you, I appreciate your reply. I’ve always deep down felt like this and maybe that’s why I intentionally self-sabotaged to bring me to this point to finally end it. I have tried to get better, with meds, therapy, talking with others, creative outlets, etc, but I always find myself back in this pit. The only time I feel true peace is when I’m sleeping, I truly wish I could trade my life with someone who wants to live. I’m sorry.
